 Versus

Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Deepak Ajay Joshi, learned counsel for the
petitioner.
2. Mr. Devesh Ghildiyal, learned Brief Holder for
the State.
3. This contempt petition is filed under Section
12 of the Contempt of Courts Act, 1971. Petitioner
alleges willful and deliberate contempt of this
Court's order dated 07.10.2025, passed in WPSS
No. 3661 of 2017, Virendra Singh & another vs.
State of Uttarakhand & others, whereby
respondents-contemnors were directed to
reconsider the case of the petitioner for
regularization as per the Regularization Rules,
2013, in the light of the judgment passed by the
Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Dharam Singh &
others vs. State of U.P. & another, reported in 2025
SCC Online SC 1735, within a period of three
months from the date of production of a certified
copy of this order.
4. Response was called from the respondents-contemnors.
5. A response/compliance affidavit has been filed,

UKHC010085662026
2026:UHC:6835
and in the said affidavit, a copy of the order dated
25.06.2026 has been annexed by the respondents-contemnors as annexure-2 to the writ petition,
whereby the case of the petitioner was considered
and rejected by the respondents-contemnors.
6. Learned counsel for the respondents-contemnors/State submits that the order has been
complied with, though the compliance has not been
made within time.
7. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that
the respondents-contemnors were directed to decide
and consider the case of the petitioner within a
period of three months from the date of production
of a certified copy of the order dated 07.10.2025,
but the compliance has not been made by the
respondents-contemnors within that period. Thus,
according to him, contempt is made out.
8. Be that as it may, the compliance has been
made, though later, after filing a contempt petition,
therefore, this Court is not inclined to proceed any
further in the matter, as the compliance has been
made. Accordingly, contempt petition is hereby
closed.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
04.08.2026 AK
